```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
movies <- read_csv("data/movies.csv")
movies
glimpse(movies)
names(movies)
```

```{r}
movies |>
  summarise(across(everything(), \(column) sum(is.na(column))))
```

```{r}
movies |>
  filter(!is.na(boxOffice)) |>
  select(title, boxOffice) |>
  slice_head(n = 10)
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
movies_clean <- movies |>
  separate_longer_delim(genre, delim = ", ")
```

```{r}
movies_clean |>
  count(genre, sort = TRUE)
```

```{r}
movies |>
  summarise(
    mean_audienceScore = mean(audienceScore, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_tomatoMeter = mean(tomatoMeter, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```

```{r}
ggplot(movies, aes(x = tomatoMeter)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 5, na.rm = TRUE) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Tomatometer Scores",
    x = "Tomatometer Score",
    y = "Count"
  )
```

```{r}
movies_gap <- movies |>
  mutate(gap = tomatoMeter - audienceScore)

movies_gap
```

```{r}
gap_by_genre <- movies_clean |>
  mutate(gap = tomatoMeter - audienceScore) |>
  group_by(genre) |>
  summarise(
    mean_gap = mean(gap, na.rm = TRUE),
    movie_count = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  filter(movie_count >= 50) |>
  arrange(mean_gap)

gap_by_genre
```

```{r}
movies_gap |>
  summarise(
    mean_gap = mean(gap, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_gap = median(gap, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_gap = sd(gap, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```

```{r}
movies_summary <- movies_gap |>
  group_by(genre) |>
  summarise(
    mean_gap = mean(gap, na.rm = TRUE),
    movie_count = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  filter(movie_count >= 100) |>
  arrange(mean_gap)

movies_summary
```

```{r}
ggplot(
  movies_summary,
  aes(x = mean_gap, y = fct_reorder(genre, mean_gap))
) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0) +
  labs(
    title = "Average Critic-Audience Gap by Genre",
    subtitle = "Negative values favor audiences; positive values favor critics",
    x = "Average Gap",
    y = "Genre"
  )
```
